lore.item.aether.blue_cape: A Purple Cape that has a silky feeling to it. It's crafted using Purple and Black Wool.
lore.aether.healing_stone: A rune that can be consumed to heal your wounds.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.altar_repair: §fRepairing in an anvil uses less XP.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.ambrosium_sh: §fCombine amethyst, a tool, and material in an anvil for a modifier!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.blue_aerclou: §fA single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.champs: §fYou can keep your spawn point and skip to dawn by using a sleeping bag.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.check_surrou: §fRight click a compass to make it point to custom coordinates.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.close_door: §fDon't leave your house without closing the door.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.cold_parachu: §fAnimals will naturally respawn. Named animals won't despawn!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.dart_shooter: §fAlways assume rumors are false, rather than assuming they're true!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.darts_no_gra: §fWalking through cobwebs will eventually break them.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.dig_straight: §fDigging straight down or straight up is not a great idea.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.do_things: §fThe best time to do anything is before it's too late.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.drops: §fIf a drop looks too big, it probably is.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.dungeon_rewa: §fSometimes, you can find treasure maps in chests!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.dungeon_tier: §fCraft some recovery potions for quick healing!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.enchant_blue: §fIf you're not sure what a mob does, study it with a spyglass!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.enchanted_gr: §fRemember to use your fieldguide and spyglass!
§fStudying a mob with a spyglass will unlock it in the fieldguide.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.expectations: §fNever expect that nothing will happen while you're gone.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.glowstone_po: §fPlace water into a Glowstone frame for a Hostile Paradise.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.golden_apple: §fSome Creepers don't explode when they get close to you!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.golden_parac: §fUse shears on an apple cow for a treat!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.gravitite_ar: §fTry using lost souls on certain crops!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.gravitite_or: §fRight click with a hoe to harvest more crops at once.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.harvest_aech: §fThe Wandering Trader has some new goodies!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.icestone_fre: §fCreepers aren't the easiest source of gunpowder...
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.mimic_chest: §fGive a collar to a pet to keep it from getting hurt.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.mining: §fYou can always come back later and mine some more.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.moa_egg_incu: §fThe pet roster lets you decide if a pet will defend you, or just follow you.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.moa_nature_s: §fDying damages your tools, spills half your XP, and makes you lose newly gained hearts.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.parachute_ac: §fBreak the clusters, don't break the budding block!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.phoenix_armo: §fIf you can't find any cows for leather, you can always make it from rotten flesh in a furnace.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.phyg_saddle: §fJumping spiders won't attack you at all!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.quicksoil_sl: §fCopper tools aren't the only tools that use copper!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.raw_meat: §fGrappling hooks are a pretty fun way to get around.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.remedy_bucke: §fGliders can be enchanted for durability and speed!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.risk_taking: §fDon't take huge risks far from home.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.security: §fBe very selective who you share personal information with!
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.sheepuff_puf: §fPress R on an item to see its recipe.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.shelter: §fA shelter made of dirt is still a shelter.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.skyroot_tool: §fPress U on an item to see what recipes it's used in.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.spare_stack: §fAlways keep a spare stack of blocks in your inventory.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.the_game: §fThe game is only as fun as you make it.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.watch_your_s: §fCraft a bundle with three leather and a piece of string.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.white_aerclo: §fYou can plant crops in untilled soil.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.zephyr_shoot: §fYou can use a shulker box like a bundle!
